content:
Aditya Raman: Morning — new hire kit arrived but my external monitor (Dell U2720Q) shows "No signal" when plugged into the USB‑C dock. The laptop charges from the dock though. Anyone who handles dongles/cables? @Maya (IT) :wave:

onboarding-bot: Welcome Aditya! I've created ticket INC-2026-1123 to track this with IT. Please add any photos/logs there.

Maya (IT): Hey Aditya — sorry about that. Can you confirm dock model/label (it's on the bottom) and whether the monitor works if you plug directly into the laptop HDMI/DP? Also a pic of the cable helps.

Aditya Raman: Dock label reads "RDW-DOCK-45" serial 34A7-9C. Plugging monitor directly into laptop USB-C (no dock) gives signal OK. So laptop->monitor works, laptop->dock->monitor fails. I uploaded two photos to the ticket.

Maya (IT): Thanks. That points to the dock's DP alt-mode or the dock's DP/HDMI port. Can you run this on Windows and paste output? `ipconfig /all` and `Get-PnpDevice -FriendlyName "*Dock*"` should do.

Aditya Raman:
```
Ethernet adapter Ethernet 3:
   Media State . . . . . . . . . . . . : Media disconnected

Wireless LAN adapter Wi-Fi:
   IPv4 Address. . . . . . . . . . . . : 10.8.42.55

PS C:\> Get-PnpDevice -FriendlyName "*Dock*"
Status: Unknown
Class: USB
FriendlyName: RDW-DOCK-45
```

Maya (IT): Hm 'Media disconnected' for dock Ethernet and PnP status unknown. Try fully power‑cycling the dock: unplug power, unplug USB‑C from laptop, wait 20s, plug power back, then connect USB‑C. Also try a different USB‑C port on the laptop if available.

Aditya Raman: Tried power cycle and the alternate USB‑C port. No change — monitor still No signal, dock ethernet still disconnected. :confused:

Ingram Shipbot: Hi @Aditya — shipping can overnight a replacement USB‑C cable and a replacement dock if you want. Do you prefer spare cable only or full swap? Reply here and we can ship today.

Aditya Raman: Cable only please — seems like DP alt‑mode handshake over that cable might be flaky. If new cable doesn't help I'll take the dock swap.

Samir (Facilities): I can drop a spare cable by your desk if you're in SF office today. Ping me your desk number.

Aditya Raman: I'm remote today (WFA) — please ship. Shipping address is on file. Thanks everyone.

Ingram Shipbot: Replacement cable shipped, tracking 1Z9999W43210987654, ETA next day. Marking INC-2026-1123 as 'Awaiting customer confirmation'.

Aditya Raman: Cable arrived this morning. Plugged it in and both monitor + ethernet on dock are working now :tada: — monitor 4K @60Hz and ethernet shows 1 Gbps. Please close ticket when you see this.

Maya (IT): Awesome — closing INC-2026-1123. If it recurs we'll swap docks. Welcome aboard again! :thumbsup:
